metadata.description: RR's personal Claude Code skills and mods

plugins.name: github-issues
plugins.description: Skills to file, triage and archive GitHub issues: quick-issue, issue-triage and librarian. The issues mod does their gh steps

plugins.name: docs-ledger
plugins.description: The archivist skill, agent and hooks: a ledger in .ledger/ that keeps in-progress engineering docs current for later sessions

plugins.name: defending-findings
plugins.description: The defending-findings skill: a finding is defended, attacked and calibrated before anything acts on it

plugins.name: drive
plugins.description: /drive and four tools (testing_run, docker_stack, docs_index, drive_check) that keep the drive's testing, docker and docs folders to their manifests; cleanup runs only on /drive clean apply

plugins.name: worktree-lifecycle
plugins.description: /wt and worktree_* tools for bare-clone repos: start work, ship a draft PR on your yes, hear about the merge, housekeep when you say so, and guard the layout

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: /orchestrate runs a multi-issue plan through subagents: dev and isolated QA per slice on escalating model ladders, verified one-at-a-time integration, final QA. Needs worktree-lifecycle

plugins.name: issues
plugins.description: Six tools (issue_labels, issue_create, issue_fill, issue_link, label_ensure, issue_consolidate) that do the gh steps for GitHub issues and check each landed; a duplicate closes only on /issues consolidate
